I wasn't disappointed. I don't know how Nintendo makes such crisp graphics but it seems every game they make looks good, maybe because I'm older and loved the NES style, idk.
I wish it was a little longer but it really is a great game if it is your cup of tea.
I rated this a 10, if it's not, metacritic changed it without my permission. It was showing 8, wtf is going on?
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: 4ImprintCertain
quote:
I was so excited for this game, I mean most people were. From the moment I started I was just bummed at what we received. This is way too cut scene-y for me and way too slow paced. The graphics are ok, I'm not too picky on them so I didn't see much difference from other games on PS5 Pro but I did notice the lagging and inconsistently with the frame rates. I would much prefer slightly lower graphics for a better frame rates. I could even let that slide if I wasn't tasked to do fetch quests to please a girlfriend... Who cheats on you. I personally didn't see too many glitches but I did disappear into a wall or 2. For the hype, I am extremely disappointed. I put in 5 hours and I just don't see me going back again. Rockstar dropped the ball on this one, 5 is vastly superior. 
I rated this a 2, metacritic seems to be changing scores and made it a 7. Hopefully it stays at 2 now.
